latest.description: Your look at what's coming in the week starting Aug. 17

latest.title: Live updates: Bitcoin flat near $63,500, but the flows have quietly turned
latest.description: US spot ETFs took in more than 14,000 BTC in five days and Q3 flows have flipped positive, ARP Digital's Yusuf Fakhro says, fresh demand landing in the thinnest, most sold-out market in years.

latest.title: China's economy slows further in July as retail sales barely grow, investment slump steepens
latest.description: The data is reinforcing concerns about the health of the world's second-largest economy, which has grappled with a deepening supply-demand imbalance.

latest.title: September Fed interest-rate increase is 'very unlikely,' Goldman Sachs says
latest.description: Soft economic data has Goldman Sachs doubting a September rate increase, offering good news for bitcoin bulls.

latest.title: Treasury yields edge lower as investors look ahead to latest FOMC minutes
latest.description: Treasury yields fell as traders awaited the latest FOMC minutes due later this week.

latest.title: Strait of Hormuz shipping grinds to a halt ahead of U.S.-Iran ceasefire expiry
latest.description: Shipping traffic in the Strait of Hormuz sank to a new low as a ceasefire between the U.S. and Iran is set to expire on Monday with no deal in sight.

latest.title: Ferrari Luce: Polarizing EV becomes a $40 million collector’s item
latest.description: The auction of the Luce comes nearly three months after Ferrari unveiled its first fully electric car, which was priced at 550,000 euros (roughly $640,000).

latest.title: Greenlane’s $70M BERA treasury ends Q2 valued at $16M
latest.description: Greenlane recorded a $19.1 million noncash valuation loss as BERA’s price fell nearly 76% year to date.

latest.title: The bitcoin futures market looks like a crowded club with a tiny exit – and it could cause pain
latest.description: The market may be facing a dangerous liquidity mismatch as futures open interest outpaces trading volume by a significant margin.

latest.title: Japanese automakers vulnerable to one-two punch of Iran war, yen rally
latest.description: Japanese automakers vulnerable to one-two punch of Iran war, yen rally

latest.title: XRP traders bet on a rebound as price slips to $1 and bearish chatter surges
latest.description: Futures open interest climbed to $2.78 billion and traders on Binance and OKX leaned heavily long, even as social sentiment hit a three-month low.

latest.title: Bitcoin nears $64,000 in Asia morning hours as HYPE jumps 8% on the week
latest.description: Every major gained on Sunday, though bitcoin, ether, XRP and solana are all lower over seven days.

latest.title: Chainalysis sues US over $95M ICE contract with TRM Labs
latest.description: The sealed complaint leaves Chainalysis’ specific objections and requested remedy undisclosed as briefing continues.

latest.title: Japan second-quarter GDP grows 1.1% on an annualized basis, missing expectations
latest.description: On an annualized basis, Japan saw growth of 1.1%, against estimates of 2%.

latest.title: Data of 54,000 wallet users leaked, CLARITY odds just 10%: Hodler’s Digest
latest.description: Owners of Trezor and SafePal crypto wallets at high risk of phishing attempts after separate data leaks, CLARITY odds at 10% despite White House meeting this week.

latest.title: Believe the unbelievable in this market — things can be different this time
latest.description: Here is what's so amazing: These four unbelievably performing stocks remain the most hated and feared on Wall Street.

latest.title: Top U.S. commander acknowledges mental health issues on USS Lincoln
latest.description: Cooper's visit and statement come after reports of widespread morale and mental health concerns aboard the Lincoln.

latest.title: The SEC meeting that wasn't: State of Crypto
latest.description: There were hopes that regulators could move if the Clarity Act didn't advance, but those, too, may be paused.

latest.title: Lamborghini unveils Revuelto SV, its most powerful production car ever
latest.description: Lamborghini's Revuelto SV is a limited-edition V12 hybrid with over 1,050 horsepower, a 2.4-second 0-to-100 kph time and a $741,172 starting price.

latest.title: Gemini 3.7 Flash Review: Google's Cheap Model Isn’t Dumb Anymore
latest.description: Three weeks after a Flash release that couldn't produce a working file, Google's budget tier zero-shots a playable game. It still can't reason, and a free 27B model still writes better.
